name: Lab, Belt
description:
These "items" (which are actually a collection of many items) do not take quality modifiers; their bonus is dependent on their size. A lab is required equipment to do physical work involving one of Biology, Chemistry, Forensics, or Pharmacy. (Cerebral sciences, like Mathematics and Physics, don't require labs.) Similarly, a separate tool kit is needed to use each specialty of Armoury, Electronics Repair, Explosives, or Mechanic. Using a tool kit for the wrong specialty of the right skill gives an extra -2 to skill.

Allows you to use one skill, but at -2.

name: Basic Gear
description: Champions may just want to write Basic Gear as a single equipment entry, as all of the items below are useful in almost any situation: bandages, a cigarette lighter, duct tape, a mini flashlight, a pocket mirror, a multi-tool, a notebook, pencil, and chalk, and a wristwatch.

name: Bandages (per wound)
description: Enough bandages and aspirin (which negates -2 in pain penalties) to treat two wounds, in a zip-top bag. Only allows bandaging, not full First Aid.

name: Cigarette Lighter
description: Useful even for non-smokers.

name: Duct Tape, 15 yds.
description: A 15-yard, pocket-sized "flat roll." If used as a restraint, ST-3 or Escape roll to break free.

name: Duct Tape, 60 yds.
description: A full 60-yard roll. If used as a restraint, ST-3 or Escape roll to break free.

name: Mirror, Pocket
description: Shatter-resistant plastic.

name: Multi-Tool
description: A folding, "Leatherman"-style belt tool, that counts as improvised gear (-5) for most repairs and includes a small knife.

name: Notebook, Pencil, & Chalk
description: For taking notes - or leaving them! Waterproof.

name: Wristwatch
description: Inexpensive; no features or brand name.

name: Camcorder, Micro
description: Runs for 1 hour.

name: Camera, Digital
description:
Basic equipment for Photography. Runs for 10 hours.

If made good-quality (p. 54), weight becomes 2.5 lbs. If made fine-quality, weight becomes 10 lbs.

name: Camera, Film
description:
Basic equipment for Photography.

If made good-quality (p. 54), weight becomes 2.5 lbs. If made fine-quality, weight becomes 10 lbs.

name: Film, 36 exp.
description: A 36-exposure roll.

name: Film, Infared, 36 exp.
description: Captures images as if with Infravision. A 36-exposure roll.

name: Film, Kirlian, 36 exp.
description: Captures waves of psychic energy, identifying psi use, ghosts, and more. Kirlian photography is done at -4 to skill - or no penalty if the operator takes 15 seconds to set up each shot. A 36-exposure roll.

name: Cell Phone
description: Has a low-end camera, web browser, etc. - counts as improvised equipment (-5) for Photography, Research, and so on. Quality bonuses offset those penalties but don't affect communication. Runs for 6 hours.

name: Flare, Pen
description: A disposable launcher that shoots a signal flare up to 70 yards away. Not usable as a weapon, but can be rigged to a trip-wire (roll Traps) for perimeter security.

name: Headset, Bluetooth
description: Wireless and unencrypted, for cell phone or radio. Runs for 10 hours.

name: Radio, Handheld (5 mi.)
description: 5-mile range. Runs for 10 hours.

name: Radio, Pocket (2 mi.)
description: 2-mile range. Runs for 10 hours.

name: Computer, Desktop (C3)
description: With monitor, speakers, webcam, etc. Complexity 3.

name: Computer, Laptop (C3)
description: Wi-fi enabled. -1 to skill for long tasks. Complexity 3. Runs for 5 hours.

name: PDA, Basic (C1)
description: -2 to skill for long tasks. Complexity 1, able to run one or two minor programs ("apps") simultaneously. Runs for 5 hours.

name: PDA, Full-Featured (C2)
description: As a basic PDA (-2 to skill for long tasks; runs for 5 hours), but Complexity 2, able to run up to 20 apps.

name: Backpack, Small (50 lbs.)
description:
Stuff to put other stuff in is mundane, but important. Quality bonuses add to rolls to Ready things quickly, and offset Stealth penalties for encumbrance. All weights are empty weight.

Holds 50 lbs. of gear. Quick-release allows dropping it as a free action.

name: Balloon, Empty
description:
Stuff to put other stuff in is mundane, but important. Quality bonuses add to rolls to Ready things quickly, and offset Stealth penalties for encumbrance. All weights are empty weight.

Used to hold holy water (p. 57). A filled balloon weighs 0.5 lb.; treat it as a nondamaging grenade (p. 63) in combat. Any fall automatically pops all filled balloons you're carrying. Sold in packs of 10.

name: Balloon, Filled
description:
Stuff to put other stuff in is mundane, but important. Quality bonuses add to rolls to Ready things quickly, and offset Stealth penalties for encumbrance. All weights are empty weight.

Used to hold holy water (p. 57). A filled balloon weighs 0.5 lb.; treat it as a nondamaging grenade (p. 63) in combat. Any fall automatically pops all filled balloons you're carrying. Sold in packs of 10.

name: Bottle, Empty
description:
Stuff to put other stuff in is mundane, but important. Quality bonuses add to rolls to Ready things quickly, and offset Stealth penalties for encumbrance. All weights are empty weight.

A half-pint glass bottle, sturdier than a balloon, but used in the same way. Weighs 0.6 lb. filled. A successful hit does thr cr, at -2 per die; at least 1 point of damage must be done for the bottle to break. Any fall has a 2-in-6 chance of breaking each bottle (empty or full) you're carrying.

name: Bottle, Filled
description:
Stuff to put other stuff in is mundane, but important. Quality bonuses add to rolls to Ready things quickly, and offset Stealth penalties for encumbrance. All weights are empty weight.

A half-pint glass bottle, sturdier than a balloon, but used in the same way. Weighs 0.6 lb. filled. A successful hit does thr cr, at -2 per die; at least 1 point of damage must be done for the bottle to break. Any fall has a 2-in-6 chance of breaking each bottle (empty or full) you're carrying.

name: Load-Bearing Vest (20 lbs.)
description:
Stuff to put other stuff in is mundane, but important. Quality bonuses add to rolls to Ready things quickly, and offset Stealth penalties for encumbrance. All weights are empty weight.

Carries 20 lbs. of small articles ergonomically, allowing everything to be retrieved with a Ready maneuver or Fast-Draw roll.

name: Bolt Cutters (8d(2) cut)
description: Do 8d(2) cut to padlocks, chains, etc.

name: Detonator, Fuse
description: Light the match and run away!

name: Detonator, Remote
description: Matched transmitter-receiver pair (0.5 lb. each) with 5-mile range.

name: Detonator, Timed
description: Electronic clock allows for specific detonations.

name: Dynamite, Stick (9d+1 cr ex)
description:
The prices for dynamite, plastique, and thermite assume that the champion is able to acquire them via a Contact or Patron who has legal access to explosives. If not, he'll have to get them on the black market (at 1d+1 times the price) or use Chemistry or Explosives to make them himself (half price; failure wastes the money, critical failures go boom).

Roll against Explosives (Demolition) to blow things up properly. To multiply the damage done by N, use (N × N) times as much; e.g., to do 4× the damage with dynamite, use 16 sticks. Before blowing anything up, though, be sure to read Hearing Shots (p. 61) and the note under Grenades (p. 63).

Does 9d+1 cr ex damage. Needs a detonator.

name: Go-Bar
description: Used with Forced Entry to break locks, hinges, etc.

name: Lockpicks
description: Basic equipment for Lockpicking skill. Weight becomes 0.5 lb. if made good-quality (p. 54) or 2 lbs. if made fine-quality.

name: Plastique (5dx3 cr ex)
description:
The prices for dynamite, plastique, and thermite assume that the champion is able to acquire them via a Contact or Patron who has legal access to explosives. If not, he'll have to get them on the black market (at 1d+1 times the price) or use Chemistry or Explosives to make them himself (half price; failure wastes the money, critical failures go boom).

Roll against Explosives (Demolition) to blow things up properly. To multiply the damage done by N, use (N × N) times as much; e.g., to do 4× the damage with dynamite, use 16 sticks. Before blowing anything up, though, be sure to read Hearing Shots (p. 61) and the note under Grenades (p. 63).

Self-adhesive block; does 5d×3 cr ex damage. -8 to detect via smell. Needs a detonator.

name: Thermite (3d burn/25 sec)
description:
The prices for dynamite, plastique, and thermite assume that the champion is able to acquire them via a Contact or Patron who has legal access to explosives. If not, he'll have to get them on the black market (at 1d+1 times the price) or use Chemistry or Explosives to make them himself (half price; failure wastes the money, critical failures go boom).

Roll against Explosives (Demolition) to blow things up properly. To multiply the damage done by N, use (N × N) times as much; e.g., to do 4× the damage with dynamite, use 16 sticks. Before blowing anything up, though, be sure to read Hearing Shots (p. 61) and the note under Grenades (p. 63).

Not an explosive, but hot enough to burn through steel. Does 3d burn per second on contact, treating all DR as semi-ablative! Ignite with a match or lighter; a package burns for 25 seconds.

name: Wire Cutters (2d(2) cut)
description: Do 2d(2) cut to cables, fences, etc.

name: Bayonet, Long Arm
description:
These make it easier to use or access your firearms (pp. 61-62). Only holsters and slings can take quality modifiers; the bonus applies to Fast-Draw rolls.

Allows a long arm to stab for thr+3 impaling damage, at Reach 1, using Spear skill. A sidearm instead acts as a large knife (p. B272). Either gives -1 to Guns while fixed. Wooden stakes cost 10% as much, but allow only thrusts at -1 to impaling damage and armor divisor (0.5).

description:
These make it easier to use or access your firearms (pp. 61-62). Only holsters and slings can take quality modifiers; the bonus applies to Fast-Draw rolls.

description:

name: Bayonet, Pistol (Wooden)
description:

name: Holster
description:
These make it easier to use or access your firearms (pp. 61-62). Only holsters and slings can take quality modifiers; the bonus applies to Fast-Draw rolls.

Keeps a pistol accessible, and avoids the -2 to Fast-Draw (Pistol) penalty for drawing from your pocket, belt, etc.

name: Holster, Concealed
description:
These make it easier to use or access your firearms (pp. 61-62). Only holsters and slings can take quality modifiers; the bonus applies to Fast-Draw rolls.

Keeps a pistol accessible, and avoids the -2 to Fast-Draw (Pistol) penalty for drawing from your pocket, belt, etc. A concealed holster is low-profile and worn under clothing. Gives +1 to Holdout.

name: Reflex Sight
description:
These make it easier to use or access your firearms (pp. 61-62). Only holsters and slings can take quality modifiers; the bonus applies to Fast-Draw rolls.

Gives +1 to Guns skill out to 300 yards and negates -3 in darkness penalties. Not cumulative with targeting laser!

name: Scope (+1)
description:
These make it easier to use or access your firearms (pp. 61-62). Only holsters and slings can take quality modifiers; the bonus applies to Fast-Draw rolls.

Gives from +1 to +5 Acc after aiming for seconds equal to the bonus and negates -1 in darkness penalties from aimed shots, but adds -1 Bulk.

name: Scope (+2)
description:

description:

name: Scope (+5)
description:

Gives from +1 to +5 Acc after aiming for seconds equal to the bonus and negates -1 in darkness penalties from aimed shots, but adds -1 Bulk.

name: Silencer
description:
These make it easier to use or access your firearms (pp. 61-62). Only holsters and slings can take quality modifiers; the bonus applies to Fast-Draw rolls.

Reduces the odds of being heard (Hearing Shots, p. 61), but adds -1 Bulk to the gun. Takes three seconds to remove or detach. Not available for revolvers!

name: Sling
description:
These make it easier to use or access your firearms (pp. 61-62). Only holsters and slings can take quality modifiers; the bonus applies to Fast-Draw rolls.

Lets you Fast-Draw your long arm, and safely drop it without losing or damaging it. You may also brace against it when you aim (p. B364), removing the need for a bipod.

name: Tactical Light
description:
These make it easier to use or access your firearms (pp. 61-62). Only holsters and slings can take quality modifiers; the bonus applies to Fast-Draw rolls.

When targeting a foe within 25 yards, use the current darkness penalty or -3, whichever is better. Makes you highly visible at night!

name: Targeting Laser, Integral (Sidearm/Bow)
description:
These make it easier to use or access your firearms (pp. 61-62). Only holsters and slings can take quality modifiers; the bonus applies to Fast-Draw rolls.

Gives +1 to Guns skill versus any target within range, though any opponent who notices the dot gets +1 to dodge your attack. Not cumulative with reflex sight! Sidearm: 150-yard range.

name: Targeting Laser, Integral (Rifle)
description:
These make it easier to use or access your firearms (pp. 61-62). Only holsters and slings can take quality modifiers; the bonus applies to Fast-Draw rolls.

Gives +1 to Guns skill versus any target within range, though any opponent who notices the dot gets +1 to dodge your attack. Not cumulative with reflex sight! Rifle: 750-yard range.

name: Flashlight, Mini (5 yds.)
description:
In the area of illumination listed for each source, the darkness penalty cannot be worse than -3. Quality bonuses affect this limit (e.g., a fine-quality flashlight would reduce the darkness penalty to -1).

5-yard beam. Runs for 10 hours.

name: Flashlight, Regular (10 yds.)
description:
In the area of illumination listed for each source, the darkness penalty cannot be worse than -3. Quality bonuses affect this limit (e.g., a fine-quality flashlight would reduce the darkness penalty to -1).

10-yard beam. Runs for 50 hours.

name: Flashlight, Smart (5/50 yds.)
description:
In the area of illumination listed for each source, the darkness penalty cannot be worse than -3. Quality bonuses affect this limit (e.g., a fine-quality flashlight would reduce the darkness penalty to -1).

Can switch between a 50-yard beam (runs for 2 hours) or a 5-yard beam (40 hours).

name: Glow Stick (2 yds.)
description:
In the area of illumination listed for each source, the darkness penalty cannot be worse than -3. Quality bonuses affect this limit (e.g., a fine-quality flashlight would reduce the darkness penalty to -1).

2-yard radius. Lasts for 12 hours.

name: Lantern, Electric (5 yds.)
description:
In the area of illumination listed for each source, the darkness penalty cannot be worse than -3. Quality bonuses affect this limit (e.g., a fine-quality flashlight would reduce the darkness penalty to -1).

5-yard radius. Runs for 20 hours.

name: UV Bulb
description:
In the area of illumination listed for each source, the darkness penalty cannot be worse than -3. Quality bonuses affect this limit (e.g., a fine-quality flashlight would reduce the darkness penalty to -1).

Roll vs. DX-2 or any Beam Weapons-2 to hit with the beam; the target may try to dodge. If your opponent has a Weakness to sunlight, then a hit inflicts half that disadvantage's damage. Changing bulbs takes 10 seconds (five seconds with a DX roll). Fits any flashlight.

name: Body Bag
description: Sometimes necessary to keep a corpse secret!

name: Crash Kit
description: Basic equipment for Physician; improvised equipment (-5) for Surgery; fine equipment (+2) for First Aid.

name: First Aid Kit
description: Basic equipment for First Aid. Weight becomes 2 lbs. if made good-quality (p. 54); fine-quality is a crash kit (above).

name: Surgical Kit
description: Basic equipment for Surgery (+2 for TL; see p. B424).

name: Climbing Kit (w/100 yds. rope)
description: Harness, ascender, descender, fasteners, and 100 yards of 3/8" rope.

name: Disguise Kit
description: Basic equipment for Disguise. Weight becomes 50 lbs. if made good-quality (p. 54) or 250 lbs. if made fine-quality.

name: Grapnel
description: Padded for stealth! Use Throwing to place.

name: Industrial Cleanser
description: Roll vs. Housekeeping to destroy DNA evidence. Enough for one body's worth.

name: Library
description: Allows Research rolls on the occult from the comfort of one's home. May be physical books or a virtual collection on the computer (p. 54) - either way, weight is irrelevant.

name: Media Player
description: If made good-quality (p. 54), can either play video files or record audio; if made fine-quality, can do both. Runs for 12 hours.

name: Reloading Press
description: For hand-loading special ammo (p. 63) with Armoury (Small Arms).

name: Rope, 3/8 in. x 10 yds.
description: Supports 650 lbs.

name: Binoculars
description:
Each type of optic provides the effects of the listed traits while being used. Goggles are dangerous to wear when fighting - No Depth Perception gives -1 to melee combat, and -3 to ranged!

Telescopic Vision 3.

name: Binoculars, Night-Vision
description:
Each type of optic provides the effects of the listed traits while being used. Goggles are dangerous to wear when fighting - No Depth Perception gives -1 to melee combat, and -3 to ranged!

Night Vision 9, Telescopic Vision 4, and Colorblindness. Run for 20 hours.

name: Binoculars, Thermal-Imaging
description:
Each type of optic provides the effects of the listed traits while being used. Goggles are dangerous to wear when fighting - No Depth Perception gives -1 to melee combat, and -3 to ranged!

Infravision, Telescopic Vision 2, and Colorblindness. Run for 4 hours.

name: Goggles, Night-Vision
description:
Each type of optic provides the effects of the listed traits while being used. Goggles are dangerous to wear when fighting - No Depth Perception gives -1 to melee combat, and -3 to ranged!

Night Vision 9, Colorblindness, No Depth Perception, and No Peripheral Vision. Hands-free. Run for 20 hours.

name: Goggles, Thermal-Imaging
description:
Each type of optic provides the effects of the listed traits while being used. Goggles are dangerous to wear when fighting - No Depth Perception gives -1 to melee combat, and -3 to ranged!

Infravision, Telescopic Vision 3, Colorblindness, No Depth Perception, and No Peripheral Vision. Hands-free. Run for 2 hours.
